quickScale.postgresHint: Writes use the primary. Applications must use the separate reader connection for reads; replicas can lag.
quickScale.redisHint: Replicas provide automatic failover. Redis replication is asynchronous; a failover can lose recent writes.
quickScale.redisShardHint: Sharding distributes keys across partitions and requires a Redis Cluster client.
quickScale.disconnectReaders: Disconnect reader connections before removing the final replica.
quickScale.redisStandalone: To enable replication, restore a saved backup into a new replicated database, verify its data, then switch the application connection.
quickScale.invalidCount: Choose a supported whole-number instance count.
quickScale.capacityHint: Each database instance needs its own disk and a separate server with sufficient capacity. No servers are purchased automatically.
quickScale.rebalanceReview: This redistributes keys between shards. A verified backup is required; requests may slow while data moves.
quickScale.replicationReview: The operator manages replication and placement. New replicas become ready after their data has synchronized.
quickScale.staleReview: This database changed after review. Refresh the draft and review again.
quickScale.unchanged: This instance count is already configured.
quickScale.backupRequired: Configure a backup destination before changing the shard count.
quickScale.operationPending: Wait for the current operation to finish before scaling.
quickScale.readerHint: Adds a private reader URL. Queries must use this variable explicitly. Replica data may lag; credentials remain encrypted.
quickScale.connectionSaved: Connection saved. Redeploy the application to apply it.
quickScale.distinctVariables: Use different variables for write and reader connections.
quickScale.singleReaderWarning: With one read replica, writes pause if that replica is unavailable. Two read replicas are recommended for failure headroom.
quickScale.setupHint: Uses the selected servers. Your application stays in place until you review a deployment.
quickScale.adminSetup: A server administrator must enable scaling. You can watch its progress here.
quickScale.closeSetupHint: Closing keeps setup progress. Reopening reads the saved operation.
quickScale.appScaleUp: New instances become available after health checks. Existing instances continue serving traffic.
quickScale.appScaleDown: The runtime removes extra instances using its normal shutdown process.
quickScale.settingsChanged: Settings changed. Close this review and check the current values.
quickScale.redisDownscale: Replicated Redis can add replicas here. To reduce them, restore a backup into a new database and switch after verification.
quickScale.restoreReplicationHint: Restores into a separate database. The original data and application connections stay unchanged until you explicitly switch them.
quickScale.sentinelHint: Automatic failover uses 3 additional Sentinel voters, limited to 0.75 vCPU and 768 MiB in total.
